messages:
anya: Heads up: packaging found a digest mismatch for private-vpc installer v1.8.0-rc2 on the mirror. Suggest we hold tonight's canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: private-vpc/installer v1.8.0-rc2 -> staging-canary @ 2026-03-24T22:00Z. Use /hold to pause.
sam: What's mismatching? sha256 vs CI artifact?
anya: Quick check: CI produced sha256 c0ffeec0..., mirror shows d34db33... Looks like old cached blob.
ops-oncall: Checking cosign sigs. One shard signed pre-rotation (2026-02-28). Mirror didn't refresh after signer rotation.
maria: Agree hold. We'll repackage with live signer, refresh shrinkwrap, sign, verify checksums, then reschedule.
lee: Rollback criteria unchanged: abort on any cosign mismatch or >1% client checksum failures. Also abort on latency regression >20%.
anya: Rebuilding artifacts now with --no-cache and pinning signer. Will open PR to pin packager signer.
ops-oncall: Mirror republish in progress. ETA ~20m. Will post final sha256 + cosign ok.
maria: I'll update release notes to mention hold due to key rotation and repack.
sam: Also tag artifact as rc2-20260324-signed to avoid ambiguous tags.
ops-oncall: Cosign verified, mirror checksums match: sha256 c0ffeec0... Reschedule proposed: 22:45Z.
lee: Reschedule OK. Please add one-line postmortem to release notes.
anya: PR opened: packager/pin-signer-20260324. Republish complete.
deploy-bot: Deploy rescheduled: private-vpc/installer v1.8.0-rc2 -> staging-canary @ 2026-03-24T22:45Z (tag rc2-20260324-signed).
